Binary-Greedy-Mesher-For-Voxel-Graphic-Generation-In-Lua
Slow greedy meshing times - The project uses bitwise operations encoded at machine level to greatly reduce the number of clock cycles used to greedy mesh a chunk of voxels. Lack of face culling - The project greatly reduces the number of vertices and draw calls being made due to the use of Editable Meshes rather than traditional Part based Methods.
